# Security

For a security issue affecting `moaaztaha.com`, email
`security@moaaztaha.com`. Please do not open a public issue with exploit details
or personal data.

The published disclosure contact and current policy are available at
<https://moaaztaha.com/.well-known/security.txt>.

For vulnerabilities in third-party products referenced by the research archive,
contact the relevant vendor or programme; this repository cannot accept or
coordinate those reports.
